analysis.title: Cadence Design Systems Inc. (CDNS): Strong guidance suggests momentum in AI tool adoption and recurring revenue growth
key_insights: GS expects CDNS to move higher after a solid 3Q26 print and a raised 2026 guide. Expectations had risen into the quarter as concerns about open-source AI disruption eased and management and peers gave more clarity on AI monetization.
3Q26 revenue was $1.63bn versus GS $1.62bn and Street $1.62bn. Non-GAAP operating margin was 44.1% versus 44.2% for both GS and the Street. Non-GAAP EPS (excl. SBC) was $2.11 versus $2.05 for both.
Core EDA delivered about 18% Y/Y organic recurring revenue growth. Management expects agentic AI tools to drive higher consumption of the underlying EDA tool base.
Cadence introduced a consumption-plus-subscription model for the agent layer and kept subscriptions for the underlying tools. GS believes this could support accelerating revenue growth over time.
Maestro is a set of domain-specific, post-trained AI models for EDA tasks plus a model router that picks the most efficient model to save tokens. It is integrated with Cadence's existing tools.
IP revenue was $245mn, up over 30% Y/Y, led by AI/HPC demand, with emerging opportunities in automotive and robotics and expanded partnerships with Samsung Foundry and a leading space company.
Hardware revenue was a record of over $100mn. Demand for Palladium Z3 and Protium X3 continues to outpace supply as verification complexity rises.

2026 revenue guidance was raised to $6.387-$6.417bn (midpoint $6.402bn) from $6.26-$6.34bn, including the Hexagon acquisition that closed Feb. 23. The midpoint is above GS at $6.38bn and the Street at $6.33bn.
2026 EPS guidance was raised to $8.37-$8.43 (midpoint $8.40) from $8.05-$8.15 prior, including Hexagon dilution. The midpoint is above GS at $8.20 and the Street at $8.16.
4Q26 guidance midpoint is revenue $1,710mn versus Street $1,651mn and EPS $2.04 in line with the Street. GS was at $1,702mn revenue and $2.08 EPS.
GS raised EPS estimates by an average of 3%: 2026E to $8.40 from $8.20, 2027E to $10.30 from $10.00, and 2028E to $12.00 from $11.50.
GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month price target of $470, based on 45x applied to normalized EPS of $10.50. The stock closed at $322.17 on 26 Oct 2026.
Backlog ended the quarter at $8.2bn, up from $8.1bn the prior quarter.
GS expects a modestly positive read-through for peer Synopsys (SNPS) given similar customer and end-market exposure.

market_movers.rationale: GS sees CDNS as one of the highest-quality compounders in its coverage, with leverage to AI monetization, IP and hardware emulation momentum, and physical AI. The target is 45x normalized EPS of $10.50.
GS expects a modestly positive reaction in SNPS from the CDNS print because of similar customer and end-market exposure.

sector_views.rationale: AI agentic tools are expected to raise consumption of base EDA tools, and new AI products like Maestro add monetization paths.

earnings_insights: CDNS 3Q26 reported (10/26/2026): revenue $1,633mn versus GS est $1,621mn and Street est $1,616mn. Revenue grew 22.0% Y/Y.
CDNS 3Q26 reported non-GAAP EPS (excl. SBC) $2.11 versus GS est $2.05 and Street est $2.05, a beat of 2.8-2.9%.
CDNS 3Q26 reported non-GAAP operating margin (excl. SBC) 44.1% versus GS est 44.2% and Street est 44.2%.

CDNS 3Q26 reported segments: Core EDA $1,127mn versus GS est $1,122mn and Street est $1,115mn. Semiconductor IP $245mn versus GS est $229mn and Street est $235mn. System Design and Analysis $261mn versus GS est $271mn and Street est $267mn.

CDNS 4Q26 company guidance: revenue midpoint $1,710mn (range $1,595-$1,825mn) versus GS est $1,702mn and Street est $1,651mn. Non-GAAP EPS midpoint $2.04 (range $2.01-$2.07) versus GS est $2.08 and Street est $2.04.

CDNS CY2026 company guidance: revenue midpoint $6,402mn (range $6,387-$6,417mn), up 1.6% from prior guidance, versus Street est $6,325mn. Non-GAAP EPS midpoint $8.40 (range $8.37-$8.43), up 3.7% from prior guidance, versus Street est $8.16. Non-GAAP operating margin midpoint 44.7% versus Street est 44.4%.
GS estimates (not reported): 2026E EPS $8.40, 2027E EPS $10.30, 2028E EPS $12.00. 2026E revenue $6,414mn, 2027E $7,537mn, 2028E $8,550mn.
